name: Default
shortDescription: Fluidd web interface for Klipper 3D printers, served from one place and connecting from the browser to the Moonraker API of each printer you add.

alerts.message: This deploys only the web interface; your browser connects directly to each printer's Moonraker API. Because the page is served over HTTPS, Moonraker must be reachable from your browser over a secure WebSocket (wss), and its cors_domains setting must include this domain.
